findings.message: 1 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 1440px: "📰 Olfatecho Noticias — viernes 6 de noviembre (" → 4 lines (10 words, 46px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 36px or less.

findings.message: 1 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "Última edición · 6 nov 2026" (pill) above "📰 Olfatecho Noticias — viernes 6 de nov"
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.

findings.message: Decorative index numbers: "01", "02", "03", "01", "02", "03"
findings.fix: Remove them. If order truly matters, write it into the words ("First, …") or use a real <ol>.

findings.message: 6 tiny uppercase letter-spaced labels (e.g. "Última edición · 6 nov 2026", "Una mirada rápida, todos los días", "Lo que está pasando", "Olfatecho").
findings.fix: Use sentence-case text at a readable size, or delete the label.

findings.message: Emoji in the page: 📰
findings.fix: Remove. Use words or real imagery.

findings.message: 2 box-shadow(s) on elements at rest: div.hero-media → rgba(23, 20, 18, 0.18) 0px 20px 50px 0px | span → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25) 0px 8px 24px 0px
findings.fix: Remove. Separate surfaces with a tone step or space. Shadows are for things that really float (menus, dialogs, sticky bars).

findings.message: 11 thin rule(s)/divider line(s): header.site-header 1440px | div.news-item 573px | div.news-item 573px | div.news-item 573px
findings.fix: Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.

findings.message: 12 boxes drawn with a 1px outline.
findings.fix: Define a surface by its fill (one tone step from the page) or leave the content unboxed.

findings.message: Cream + terracotta palette (page background #faf7f2, text #b8431f).
findings.fix: Re-draw the palette from the library. This pairing reads as an assistant brand, not yours.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: Body text is 13.5px (the size most of the running text is set in).
findings.fix: Body copy 16–20px. Map small sizes from blueprints onto your body step.

findings.message: The running text is a soft grey on its ground (5.6:1).
findings.fix: Set body copy in the full ink (7:1 or more). Keep the muted ink for secondary notes; pages read thin and unfinished when everything is grey.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

findings.message: 32 text blocks under 13px.
findings.fix: Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.

findings.message: The first screen has no dominant element: the largest type is 46px (3.2vw) and no single picture holds a third of the viewport.
findings.fix: Make one thing lead: the headline at display size, or one large picture. A grid of many small pictures is not one thing; in blind tests jurors marked a first screen without a headline down every time. On the strongest studied sites the largest type has a median of 8.4vw.

findings.message: Only 0 element(s) moved while the page loaded and scrolled.
findings.fix: Build the motion layer (SKILL.md step 9, references/motion.md): the signature move, an entrance for the parts of every section, feedback on every control, and one moving picture. Transform and opacity only, with a reduced-motion fallback.

findings.message: 1 headline(s) switch typeface or to italic mid-line (the "one italic serif word" move).
findings.fix: Set the whole headline in one face. Emphasis comes from the words.

findings.message: Longest paragraph runs about 91 characters per line.
findings.fix: Cap paragraphs at 45–75 characters (max-width: 60ch).

findings.message: The h1 is 31px ("📰 Olfatecho Noticias — viernes 6 de noviembre (pr").
findings.fix: Set the title at display size, or make the large text of the first screen the h1.
